title: Clyde Tombaugh and Earth's small moons; gray motherships in orbit

tellings.quote: And he wrote he wrote an article, Tom Bar wrote an article saying that Earth had um some smaller moons orbiting at about 500 miles up.

plain: In the 1950s, the astronomer Clyde Tombaugh is said to have written an article saying Earth had some smaller moons orbiting about 500 miles up, tied in this story to gray motherships sitting in orbit. Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in human bodies, tells it as a researcher summarising, crediting the article but not quoting it. If true, it would mean large unknown objects were circling close to Earth and were noticed by a serious astronomer.
